evidence_map: Profile Creator output is structurally complete and declares PROFILE_PACK_CREATED with deliverable_created=true.
The output only supplies a list of relative filenames; it does not include the created profile pack, an exact artifact path/ref, or the file contents.
Profile Creator handoff routes to quality_pack_review, whose contract requires an upstream artifact and asks whether the next worker can continue without inventing.
Quality Pack cannot inspect the claimed profile pack from the producer output alone, so proceeding would require inventing or guessing where the deliverable exists.

repair_actions.why_it_fails: The producer claims PROFILE_PACK_CREATED but provides only filenames without a concrete delivered artifact or exact retrievable reference.
repair_actions.required_fix: When PROFILE_PACK_CREATED is emitted, deliver the profile pack artifact inline or provide an exact repository artifact reference that resolves the created files; then hand that artifact to Quality Pack.

remaining_risks: Current producer schema can still pass while the receiver cannot inspect the claimed deliverable.
